item.title: Amos Yee detained by ICE in the US, may be deported to S'pore
item.description: Amos Yee has been detained by the United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and may be deported to Singapore.

item.title: S’pore civil servants to get 1.3-month year-end bonus, junior officers will receive S$600 more
item.description: All Singapore civil servants will get a 1.3-month year-end bonus this year, with junior officers receiving a one-payment of S$600.

item.title: 15 CASE complaints over closure of Wan Yang foot reflexology chain, over S$29K of losses reported
item.description: CASE has received 15 complaints so far over the sudden closure of Wan Yang foot reflexology chain, with over S$29,000 in losses reported.

item.title: Bukit Merah residents complain after blocks painted red, Town Council repaints some walls
item.description: Some Bukit Merah residents have complained after their blocks were painted red, prompting the Town Council to repaint some walls.

item.title: Delivery rider allegedly seen pouring customer’s spilt porridge into container in Yio Chu Kang, customer left 'shaken'
item.description: A woman was left “shaken” after discovering that a food delivery rider had allegedly handled her spilled food before delivering it to her.

item.title: 80-year-old mother in Taiwan kills paralysed son, stuffs red envelope containing S$417 in his mouth
item.description: An elderly woman in Taiwan has been sentenced to prison after killing her 53-year-old son, who had been paralysed for most of his life.

item.title: Farmer in Thailand shot dead for demanding S$20 compensation after neighbour's cow ate his crop
item.description: A farmer in Thailand was shot dead after asking for compensation from his neighbour, whose cow had eaten his rice crop.

item.title: S'pore football fans split after retired goalkeeper Hassan Sunny says he is open to national team recall
item.description: Hassan Sunny has become the centre of discussion in the local football scene after revealing that he is open to a national team recall.

item.title: 7 cyclists occupy up to 3 lanes near VivoCity, netizens argue they are headed in different directions
item.description: A group of seven cyclists were seen taking up three lanes on a road towards Vivocity and Sentosa, sparking intense debate among netizens.

item.title: Car slams into pedestrian jaywalking at Hougang traffic crossing
item.description: A man was struck by a car while jaywalking across a pedestrian crossing in Hougang. He was conveyed conscious to the hospital.
